name: agentic-eclipse-library
description: Four Agent Skills for processing total-solar-eclipse RAW frames into a faithful HDR image of the corona (calibration and stacking, post-processing with detail filters, root-cause artefact repair — in Catalan) and for making structure images, unrolled views and coronal-motion animations with the runnable `ael` package (in English). From the 12 August 2026 eclipse project by Pere Guerra.
